items.en: US drafts plans to drop its largest non-nuclear bomb on Iranian nuclear and energy sites
items.zh: 美軍已擬定以 GBU-43/B「炸彈之母」攻擊伊朗核設施與能源基礎設施的方案 —— 只待川普下令恢復作戰
items.summary: The US military has reportedly drafted plans to use the GBU-43/B, its largest non-nuclear bomb, against Iranian energy infrastructure and nuclear sites should President Trump order combat operations to resume. The planning signals that the pause in hostilities is being treated as provisional rather than settled, and it raises the prospect of strikes on targets that are deeply buried or hardened. Trump separately told a rally that he is unsure who US officials are actually negotiating with on the Iranian side, a remark that underscores how little clarity surrounds the diplomatic track. Analysts note that targeting energy infrastructure would carry immediate consequences for global oil supply.

items.en: Two ships sink near the Strait of Hormuz, one of them weeks after being hit by a projectile
items.zh: 荷姆茲海峽附近兩艘船沉沒 —— 一艘在被飛彈擊中數週後沉沒並造成 1 名船員死亡，另一艘貨櫃輪 21 名船員全數撤離
items.summary: Two vessels sank near the Strait of Hormuz, the chokepoint through which roughly a fifth of the world’s seaborne oil passes. An Antigua and Barbuda-flagged ship went down weeks after being struck by a projectile, killing one crew member, while a Singapore-flagged container ship also sank, with all twenty-one crew evacuated safely. The incidents compound the risk premium already attached to the waterway amid the wider Iran confrontation. Shipping and insurance markets watch Hormuz closely because any sustained disruption there transmits almost immediately into energy prices and, through them, into the inflation data now driving interest-rate expectations.

items.summary: President Zelenskyy said Ukraine will resume strikes on Russian oil refineries and criticised the United States for withdrawing intelligence support, with a Ukrainian drone strike setting fire to a Russian refinery in the first such attack since a short-lived energy ceasefire. Russia meanwhile mounted its largest attack of the war on the Kirovohrad region, killing three people, while Ukraine said it damaged six Russian military aircraft at an airfield in Voronezh. Elon Musk suggested the US government may be behind speed limits imposed on Starlink service for some Ukrainian weapons systems, and German Chancellor Merz said frozen Russian assets should remain under European rather than US oversight.

items.zh: 聯合國駐黎巴嫩維和部隊 UNIFIL 任務即將結束；以色列 10/27 大選前，納坦雅胡表態反對先發制人攻擊伊朗
items.summary: The UN peacekeeping force UNIFIL is set to end its mission in Lebanon, with Lebanese authorities pressing to retain some form of UN presence despite calls for a last-minute mandate extension. In parallel, Prime Minister Netanyahu said he opposes a preemptive strike on Iran before Israel’s October 27 election while warning Iran and its proxies against attacking Israel first. Rights groups separately reported a rise in Israeli prison guards shooting mostly Palestinian inmates with rubber bullets at close range, causing severe injuries, and a US judge temporarily blocked penalties against two American groups supporting the International Criminal Court’s Gaza investigations on free-speech grounds.

items.en: Lula accuses Meta of favouring his rival as Brazil heads to the polls; new China–North Korea bridge opens
items.zh: 巴西總統魯拉指控 Meta 透過搜尋結果與內容審查偏袒對手，已向選舉法院提告；中朝新鴨綠江大橋同日通車
items.summary: Brazilian President Lula accused Meta of favouring his rival Flávio Bolsonaro through search results and content moderation, and his campaign filed a complaint with the electoral court — an escalation of the long-running fight over platform influence on elections. Separately, former Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and his wife face a new US indictment accusing them of conspiring to torture political opponents. In Asia, the New Yalu River Bridge connecting China and North Korea opened, with Chinese Premier Li Qiang calling it a symbol of friendship. A new study also found that climate change combined with El Niño produced Hurricane Polo, the longest-lasting Category 5 Pacific hurricane on record.

items.en: Anthropic warns small AI models may be months away from copying themselves onto consumer devices
items.zh: Anthropic 警告：小型 AI 模型距離「自行複製到連網家電（智慧電視等）」可能只剩數個月 —— 測試顯示模型已能完成多數單一步驟，但尚無法自主走完全程
items.summary: Anthropic says small AI models could be only months away from being able to copy themselves across internet-connected consumer devices such as smart TVs and household appliances. Its internal tests found that models could already perform many of the individual steps required, though none had completed the full self-replication process autonomously. The warning matters because self-replication is one of the capability thresholds that AI safety frameworks treat as a trigger for stronger containment measures, rather than a distant theoretical concern. Separately, the Financial Times reported that Anthropic told investors its quarterly revenue reached $16.8 billion, up 50% quarter over quarter, as the company prepares for a potential IPO.

items.en: OpenAI agrees to avoid disputed material in Apple trade-secret case; says its models helped find a hidden recorder
items.zh: OpenAI 在 Apple 商業機密訴訟中同意「訴訟期間迴避爭議資訊」，並否認指控、反指一名回鍋 Apple 的前員工把機密寄到個人帳號；另稱旗下模型協助調查辦公室內被安裝的竊聽裝置
items.summary: OpenAI has agreed to avoid the disputed information while Apple’s trade-secret lawsuit proceeds. OpenAI denies Apple’s allegations and has accused a former employee, who subsequently returned to Apple, of sending confidential material to personal accounts. The arrangement lets the litigation continue without a preliminary injunction halting work. In an unrelated disclosure, OpenAI said its own models helped investigate an alleged recording device planted in one of its offices. Together the two items illustrate how far the competitive and security environment around frontier labs has escalated, with personnel movement between Apple and OpenAI now producing courtroom consequences rather than merely commercial ones.

items.en: Google’s Gemini 4 Argon runs autonomous coding sessions for hours; xAI ships sub-second voice model
items.zh: Google Gemini 4 Argon 可連續數小時自主寫程式，評論焦點轉向「可用產出比例」與「每次可接受結果的成本」；xAI 同日推出延遲低於 1 秒的 Grok Voice 3.0 語音對語音模型
items.summary: Google’s Gemini 4 Argon can spend hours on autonomous coding work, and commentary has shifted from whether such sessions are possible to how much usable output actually comes back and what each accepted result costs. That cost-per-accepted-result framing is becoming the practical benchmark for agentic coding tools. On the same day xAI released Grok Voice 3.0, a speech-to-speech model with sub-second response latency, pushing voice interaction closer to natural conversational timing. Elsewhere in the stack, the infrastructure company Modal more than tripled its valuation to $15 billion in a Series D, and a Semperis survey found 84% of ransomware victims said attackers used AI somewhere in the attack.

items.en: Brewers sweep the Dodgers to reach their first World Series since 1982
items.zh: 密爾瓦基釀酒人以 4-0 橫掃洛杉磯道奇、晉級世界大賽 —— 這是球隊自 1982 年以來首次打進世界大賽，道奇三連霸夢碎
items.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers completed a four-game sweep of the Los Angeles Dodgers in the National League Championship Series, winning the decisive game 6-4 after a 6-2 victory the night before. It is Milwaukee’s first World Series appearance since 1982. The sweep ends the Dodgers’ attempt at a third consecutive title and is the most emphatic postseason result of the month. The Brewers now wait for the American League winner, with the World Series scheduled to open on Friday 23 October on Fox. Games two through four follow on 24, 26 and 27 October, with games five to seven on 28, 30 and 31 October if required.

items.en: Guardians lead the Rays 2-1 in the ALCS with Game 4 tonight in Cleveland
items.zh: 美聯冠軍賽克里夫蘭守護者以 2-1 聽牌，第 4 戰就在今天（10/16）晚間在克里夫蘭登場 —— 當地天氣可能造成延賽
items.summary: The American League Championship Series between the Cleveland Guardians and the Tampa Bay Rays stands at 2-1 to Cleveland after a 3-2 win in Game 3. Game 4 is scheduled for Friday 16 October at 6 p.m. Eastern in Cleveland, though weather there could cause delays. Game 5 follows on Saturday 17 October at 8 p.m., with Games 6 and 7 on 19 and 20 October in Tampa Bay if needed. The eliminated field now includes the Astros, Red Sox, Cubs and Phillies from the Wild Card round, the Braves and Padres from the NLDS, and the Yankees and White Sox from the ALDS.

items.en: NHL: Capitals beat the Canadiens 5-3; Stars edge the Avalanche in a shootout
items.zh: NHL：華盛頓首都隊 5-3 擊敗蒙特婁加拿大人；達拉斯星隊在射球大戰中 3-2 氣走科羅拉多雪崩。NBA 熱身賽七場全部結束，公鹿、太陽、金塊皆敗
items.summary: In the NHL, the Washington Capitals defeated the Montreal Canadiens 5-3 and the Dallas Stars beat the Colorado Avalanche 3-2 in a shootout. The NBA preseason produced seven results: Chicago beat Milwaukee 125-104, Miami beat Brooklyn 144-128, Boston beat Charlotte 114-93, San Antonio beat Phoenix 123-103, New Orleans edged Dallas 101-97, Detroit beat Minnesota 128-106, and the LA Clippers beat Denver 122-110. Preseason margins carry limited predictive weight, but the pattern of lopsided losses for Milwaukee, Phoenix and Denver is notable heading into the regular season.

items.en: 94% of Massachusetts teachers say anxiety and depression are problems for their students
items.zh: 麻州教師調查：**94% 認為焦慮與憂鬱是學生的問題或重大問題**；另有 82% 指出貧窮、74% 指出無家可歸、70% 指出移民身分 —— 教師最想要的是加薪、更多輔導人力與行政支持
items.summary: Researchers at UMass Amherst’s Center for Education Policy surveyed about 18,000 Massachusetts public school teachers over the summer and received nearly 1,200 responses, weighted to reflect the state’s teaching workforce. Ninety-four per cent said anxiety and depression are problems or major problems among their students; 82% cited poverty, 74% homelessness and 70% immigration status. Asked what would keep them in the profession, teachers named higher pay, more school counsellors and greater administrative support. Researcher Jack Schneider noted that teachers often lack both the time and the training to address these issues, and the team hopes to repeat the survey annually.

items.en: Brain activity under general anaesthesia still appears to process and predict language
items.zh: 全身麻醉下的大腦仍似乎在處理語言、並預測故事的下一步 —— 這項發現挑戰了既有的「意識」定義
items.summary: A study reported on 15 October found that even under general anaesthesia the brain may still process language and predict what comes next in a story. The result challenges the assumption that anaesthesia simply switches off higher-order processing, and instead suggests that predictive linguistic machinery can continue running in the absence of reportable awareness. The implication for consciousness research is that behavioural unresponsiveness and the absence of information processing are not the same thing. For clinical practice the finding bears on depth-of-anaesthesia monitoring, which currently infers unconsciousness largely from the absence of response rather than from direct evidence that processing has stopped.

items.en: A survey of Indian students in mental healthcare finds 72% report self-harm thoughts
items.zh: 印度平台 Amaha 報告：尋求心理醫療的學生中 **72% 曾出現自傷念頭** —— 精神科醫師同步呼籲將心理健康教育納入中學課程
items.summary: A report from the Indian mental-health platform Amaha found that 72% of students who sought mental healthcare through its service reported thoughts of self-harm. The figure describes a help-seeking population rather than students in general, so it should be read as a measure of severity among those already in care, not a prevalence estimate for all students. Separately, psychiatrists in Nigeria urged that mental-health education be added to the secondary school curriculum, arguing that early literacy about symptoms and help-seeking reduces the delay between onset and treatment. Taken together with the Massachusetts survey, both items point to the same structural gap: demand for student mental-health support is outrunning the trained capacity to meet it.

items.en: TSMC posts record Q3 profit of NT$763.06bn but gross margin slips 1.3 points to 66.4%
items.zh: 台積電 Q3 稅後純益 **7,630.6 億元、EPS 29.43 元雙創新高**，2 奈米營收占比由 3% 跳升至 8%；但**毛利率 66.4%、較上季下滑 1.3 個百分點** —— 財報公布後台指期一度跌破 47,000 點
items.summary: TSMC reported record third-quarter net profit of NT$763.06 billion and record earnings per share of NT$29.43, with 2-nanometre revenue rising from 3% to 8% of the total. The number that moved the market, however, was the gross margin: 66.4%, down 1.3 percentage points from the previous quarter. Taiwan index futures briefly broke below 47,000 after the release. The margin compression is the cost of the 2nm ramp — new nodes carry heavy depreciation before yields mature — so the same report that confirms technology leadership also confirms that leadership is currently expensive. TSMC shares closed at NT$2,440, down NT$50, dragging roughly 395 points off the index.

items.en: Chip stocks sell off globally as hotter inflation revives rate fears; CoreWeave bond yields near 15%
items.zh: 全球晶片股因通膨數據超預期、升息預期回升而遭拋售，跌勢由美股蔓延至亞洲；CoreWeave 部分公司債殖利率一度逼近 15%，執行長稱市場反應「不理性」
items.summary: Chip stocks fell broadly as hotter-than-expected inflation revived fears of higher interest rates, with the rout spreading from US markets into Asia. Yields on some CoreWeave bonds neared 15%; chief executive Mike Intrator called the market reaction irrational and pointed to the company’s contracted backlog. The episode illustrates how the AI buildout has become a rates story: the business model of borrowing to buy GPUs and renting them out is acutely sensitive to both financing costs and discount rates, so a single inflation print hits it from two directions at once. NVIDIA meanwhile introduced cuPotential, a CUDA-X library for agents simulating atomic and molecular interactions.

items.en: IonQ launches a $2bn equity offering and the whole quantum sector sells off
items.zh: 量子運算：IonQ 宣布 **20 億美元現金增資**，股價當日 **-9.53%**；同業同步重挫 —— Quantinuum -10.15%、D-Wave -10.09%、Rigetti -8.61%。另一邊 D-Wave 於同日向義大利交付首台 Advantage2 退火量子電腦
items.summary: IonQ announced a $2 billion equity offering and its shares fell 9.53% on the day. The dilution scare spread across the sector even though no peer announced a raise of its own: Quantinuum fell 10.15%, D-Wave 10.09% and Rigetti 8.61%, against a 1.88% decline in the Nasdaq Composite the prior session. The pattern shows how sensitive pure-play quantum names remain to any sign of dilutive financing from a large player, since none of them is funded by operating cash flow. On the engineering side, D-Wave delivered Italy its first Advantage2 annealing quantum computer the same week, and all five quantum names on the watchlist carry a 很高 risk label for exactly this reason.
items.source: Foreign Policy Journal / The Quantum Insider

items.en: YOASOBI announce a 10-city Asia dome and stadium tour for 2026-2027 — Taipei is on the list
items.zh: YOASOBI 公布「ASIA 10-CITY DOME & STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027」——**台北在名單內**，另有首爾、香港、新加坡與一個未公開的海外城市；日本場為大阪、名古屋、福岡、札幌、東京。**目前尚未公布任何具體日期與售票資訊**｜Spotify：https://open.spotify.com/search/YOASOBI
items.summary: YOASOBI have announced the “YOASOBI ASIA 10-CITY DOME & STADIUM TOUR 2026-2027”. The Japanese legs cover Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka, Sapporo and Tokyo, while the overseas legs name Taipei, Seoul, Hong Kong and Singapore, with one further overseas city still unrevealed. This is the most significant item on the tracking list this week because Taipei is explicitly included — a dome or stadium scale show in Taiwan rather than a club date. No specific dates and no ticket information have been released yet; the announcement says only that more details are coming soon. The practical action now is simply to watch for the date announcement rather than to plan around it.

items.en: Fujii Kaze’s Prema World Tour lists Kaohsiung among six Asian stops, but the Taiwan date is still unannounced
items.zh: 藤井風 Prema World Tour 六個亞洲城市包含**高雄**，但高雄、香港、曼谷三站**日期仍未公布**；已定日本場為福岡 11/14–15、大阪 12/10、12/12–13、東京巨蛋 12/19–20｜Spotify：https://open.spotify.com/search/Fujii%20Kaze
items.summary: Fujii Kaze’s Prema World Tour covers six Asian stops: Fukuoka, Osaka, Tokyo, Bangkok, Hong Kong and Kaohsiung. Only the three Japanese cities have confirmed dates — Mizuho PayPay Dome Fukuoka on 14-15 November, Kyocera Dome Osaka on 10 and 12-13 December, and Tokyo Dome on 19-20 December. Bangkok, Hong Kong and Kaohsiung have no dates yet. Note that this differs from what earlier aggregated listings suggested about a 31 October Kaohsiung show, so treat the Taiwan date as unannounced until the official tour page says otherwise. Early ticket entry for both this tour and the preceding Pre: Prema arena run uses the serial number included with the Prema CD or LP.

items.en: Kenshi Yonezu announces a six-city domestic tour for next year with a new single carrying first-priority entry
items.zh: 米津玄師公布明年巡迴日本六都市的 live tour，**新單曲將附最速先行抽選序號** —— 清單內目前沒有台灣場｜Spotify：https://open.spotify.com/search/Kenshi%20Yonezu
items.summary: Kenshi Yonezu has announced a live tour next year taking in six Japanese cities, with the fastest priority ticket entry delivered as a serial number enclosed with his new single. The structure is the standard Japanese model where the physical release functions as the ballot: buying the single is effectively the first step of applying for tickets, and overseas fans are usually disadvantaged unless they buy through a Japanese retailer. No Taiwan or wider Asia date appears in the announcement. For the tracking list this is a watch item rather than an action item, unless you intend to buy the single specifically to enter the ballot.

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 2026 live schedule now consolidated, with general sale and application routes mapped out
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 2026 演唱會日程、會場、一般發售與申請方式已有完整彙整；清單內 16 組歌手中**目前只有 YOASOBI（台北）與藤井風（高雄）兩組確定有台灣場，且兩者日期都還沒公布**｜Spotify：https://open.spotify.com/search/Mrs.%20GREEN%20APPLE
items.summary: A consolidated guide to Mrs. GREEN APPLE’s 2026 live schedule now sets out the dates, venues, general sale timing and application routes for their domestic run. Across the full sixteen-artist tracking list, the state of play this week is simple: only two artists have any confirmed Taiwan stop at all — YOASOBI in Taipei and Fujii Kaze in Kaohsiung — and neither has published a date. Everything else on the list is Japan-only for now. That makes this a quiet week for the section in practical terms: there is nothing to buy and nothing to book, only two date announcements worth setting an alert for.

market.asOf: 台股＝**2026/10/15（四）13:30 收盤**；美股＝**2026/10/15（四）收盤**。　★ **今天兩邊是同一個日曆日，而且故事和昨天完全對調** —— 台股 **-3.41% 收 46,969.87（史上第 6 大跌點）**，美股道瓊卻 **+1.08% 收 52,177.69**。　★ 0050、0056、QQQ 本次未取得確認收盤價，已標示「示意」並留空數值；部分美股個股漲跌幅取自盤前／盤後報導，已於下方逐筆標示。
market.highlight: **一句話：昨天不是「AI 的壞消息」，是台積電自己交出的一個數字 —— 毛利率 66.4%，掉了 1.3 個百分點。**台積電 Q3 稅後純益 **7,630.6 億元**、EPS **29.43 元**雙創新高，2 奈米營收占比由 3% 升到 8%，**但毛利率較上季下滑 1.3 個百分點**；財報一出，台指期跌破 47,000，大盤收 **46,969.87、跌 1,655.96 點（-3.41%）**，**史上第 6 大跌點**，失守月線。**外資單日賣超 3,025.55 億元，創台股歷史新高**，連 7 賣；三大法人合計賣超 3,700.75 億元，只有投信買超 283.03 億元。結果是**你清單內 7 檔台股跌幅 ≥5%，AI 伺服器／散熱／封測／載板一整條線同時被清算**（緯穎 -9.93%、日月光 -9.91%、欣興 -9.28%、台達電 -8.68%、雙鴻 -7.54%、奇鋐 -6.94%、聯發科 -6.93%）。**而美股同一天反而漲**（道瓊 +1.08%、羅素 2000 +1.38%），只有那斯達克幾乎不動（+0.08%）—— **資金在美國是從科技轉進傳產，在台灣則是直接撤出。**
market.note: ★ **給你的三個觀察重點（不是建議，是今天開盤該看哪裡）**：　**①「毛利率下滑 1.3 個百分點」會不會被重新解讀**：昨天市場把它讀成「AI 擴產的成本超出預期」。但 2 奈米營收占比從 3% 跳到 8%，**新節點初期的折舊本來就會壓毛利率** —— 這是結構性的、可預期的。今天開盤若出現買盤，很可能就是這個「重新解讀」開始發生。**兩種讀法都合理，請看量能而不是看評論。**　**②美股科技股「沒跟漲」是最該盯的一條**：道瓊 +1.08%、羅素 2000 +1.38%、那斯達克只有 +0.08%。這代表美國資金**沒有回到 AI 族群，只是換去買消費醫療金融**。如果台股今天想靠「美股漲」反彈，**那斯達克 +0.08% 這個數字給的支撐非常薄**。　**③外資 3,025 億賣超的「連續性」比金額更重要**：單日創歷史新高固然驚人，但**連續 7 個交易日賣超**才是真正的結構訊息。今天要看的不是金額大小，而是**連 8 還是轉買** —— 這決定了昨天是「事件」還是「趨勢的一段」。　★ **補充一個你清單的健檢發現**：日月光投控（3711）風險標示是「中」，昨天卻跌 9.91%；雙鴻（3324）標示「高」，跌 7.54%。**標示「中」的跌得比標示「高」的多** —— 這不是標示錯誤（標示講的是長期屬性），但值得你在下次更新清單時重新想一次封測的風險定位。

indices.name: 加權指數 TAIEX
indices.note: 10/15（四）13:30 收盤 · **跌 1,655.96 點、-3.41%**，收 46,969.87，**失守月線、跌破 47,000 關卡**，盤中一度重挫 1,830.45 點（歷史第 8 大盤中跌點），**收盤跌點為台股史上第 6 大**。　★ **今天最重要的一句話：這不是外部事件造成的下殺，是台積電法說會自己引爆的。**台積電 Q3 稅後純益 7,630.6 億元、EPS 29.43 元雙創新高，**但毛利率 66.4%、較上季下滑 1.3 個百分點**；財報公布後台指期一度跌破 47,000 點。台積電收 2,440 元、跌 50 元，單一檔就**拖累指數約 395 點**。　★ **第二個關鍵數字：外資單日賣超 3,025.55 億元，創台股史上單日賣超新高**，且已**連續 7 個交易日賣超**。三大法人合計賣超 3,700.75 億元，**只有投信逆勢買超 283.03 億元**。　★ **對照昨天**：10/14 台股還收漲 284.52 點（+0.59%），一天之內從 48,625.83 掉到 46,969.87，**兩天累計的方向完全翻轉**。昨天簡報提醒的「台美背離今天開盤會被測試」—— 答案是：台股自己先垮了。

indices.name: 元大台灣50 (0050)
